title: Recent Travel Experiences with the Pretérito Perfecto

sections.content: Use the pretérito perfecto for recent travel experiences and actions connected to the present. Form it with haber plus the past participle: he *viajado*, *hemos* *visitado*, *han* *conocido*. It works well with recent experiences and open time periods.

items.english: I have travelled a lot this year.
Have you discovered a new place?

sections.content: *Haber* and the participle can never be split: *he viajado mucho*, never *he mucho viajado*. English lets adverbs wedge into the middle of its perfect tense; Spanish simply doesn't allow that.
